name: Sunnyvale (United States)
description: A blue vertical stripe at the hoist of one third of the length bearing a gold thirty-two-pointed sun with four longer compass points, and a fly of white over gold.
history: Sunnyvale is a town in Dallas County, Texas. The flag was adopted on 27 April 2015 (adopted by resolution of the Town Council on 27 April 2015, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: thirty-two-pointed sun with four longer points for the communities of Hattersville, Long Creek, New Hope and Tripp
